_README: Every key in this file becomes a --dart-define, and a key with an EMPTY value is DEFINED, not absent: String.fromEnvironment falls back to its defaultValue only when the key is missing entirely. So never add a key here just to document it - an empty value overwrites the compiled-in default with nothing. SENTRY_DSN is safe empty because its compiled default is empty too (crash reporting off). Two more keys exist and are deliberately NOT listed: OFF_MIRROR_URL and OFF_MIRROR_SEARCH_KEY, the base URL and the search-only key of the product-search mirror. Their defaults in lib/src/config/search_config.dart are the working production values; add them only to point a build at your own Meilisearch index (an empty OFF_MIRROR_URL is the hard local kill switch). See README, section Product-search key rotation.
